name: Authority and Auditability
description: Tribunus's core differentiator. Owns receipts, evidence chains, capability checks, approval gates, durable ACKs, authority binding, identity-bound actions, replayability, signed artifacts, policy evaluation, escalation, revocation. Defines what must be proven before any subsystem can claim completion.
objective: Define and implement the authority layer: every action produces verifiable receipts with durable evidence chains. No claim without observable backing.
